description: Read live traffic data for Germany's motorways from the official API of Die Autobahn GmbH des Bundes. List the roadworks, traffic warnings and closures on one or more motorways, with their dates, time slots, direction, length and width limits; find truck parking areas and fast charging stations along a route; and look any of them up by id. Triggers fire on a new warning, a new closure or new roadworks on a motorway. No account or API key required.
